Calendar

One lecture session per week. Problem sets are due one week after the sessions they cover; see Assignments and Exams.

Ses #TopicMain deliverable

1From Probability to the Linear Regression ModelOLS derivation and projection geometry
2OLS Inference: Sampling Distributions, Hypothesis Tests, and Confidence Intervalst/F/Wald inference exercise

Part II · Endogeneity and identification
5Endogeneity, Instrumental Variables, and Two-Stage Least SquaresInstrument validity memo
6Simultaneous Equations and Structural IdentificationIdentification conditions exercise

8Dynamic Panels, Difference GMM, and System GMMGMM moment-condition defense

9Time-Series Foundations: Stationarity, ARMA, and ForecastingStationarity and ARMA lab
10Unit Roots, Structural Breaks, and PersistenceDeterministic specification report

Part V · Causal inference and research practice
13Causal Inference: Potential Outcomes, DiD, and Regression DiscontinuityDiD/RD design memo
14Research Design, Monte Carlo, Replication, and ReportingReproducible empirical presentation
